title: Form 1098-E box 1 student loan interest statement items, tax year 2025
closure_claim: Every student loan interest amount reported in box 1 of a Form 1098-E furnished to the taxpayer for tax year 2025 is recorded as a statement item as of the keyed horizon. This claim covers Form 1098-E box 1 (and its box-2 companion) only: it says nothing about the twelve Student Loan Interest Deduction eligibility components, MAGI completeness, Schedule 1 Part II completeness, or Form 1040 line 10/11a/11b completeness. A VOID-checked copy is never admitted as a member at all -- not a member, not a correction, not evidence of anything. Closed with members authorizes the multi-lender sum of current members; closed-empty authorizes subtotal 0.
